# The Builder's Hive Mobile Copilot Instructions

- This is an Expo SDK 54 React Native app written in TypeScript.
- Keep app logic inside `src/` and use `App.tsx` only to wire screens together.
- The login flow uses `axios` against `https://localhost:5015/api/account/login`.
- Keep the home screen focused on the authenticated user returned by the API.
- Keep the UI\UX theme consistent with the home screen, MyTasksPanel and TaskDetailsPanel.
- In case of any confusion or ambiguity, ask all the questions for clarification before proceeding.
- Update `README.md` whenever run or build steps change.
